claims.subject: Pizzarelli quasi-2-D cooling-channel model
claims.object: 1-D coolant mass and momentum equations with a 2-D (x, radial y) coolant energy balance coupled to radial wall heat transfer
claims.statement: The quasi-2-D model uses one-dimensional governing equations for coolant mass and momentum and a two-dimensional governing equation for coolant energy, coupled to the wall heat-transfer balance in the radial direction; turbulent conductivity, skin friction and heat-transfer coefficients come from semiempirical literature relationships.
qualifiers: stated suited to high aspect ratio cooling channels

claims.subject: HARCC in European engines
claims.object: cooling-passage aspect ratio as high as 8 in the throat region (Vulcain, Vulcain 2) [5,6]
claims.statement: The thrust chambers of Vulcain and Vulcain 2 have cooling passages with aspect ratio as high as 8 in the throat region [5,6]; increasing aspect ratio k = h/b lowers the hot-gas-side wall temperature mainly by increasing coolant-side surface area.
qualifiers: cited engine data, not a model-validity statement
claims.quote: are characterized by cooling passages, with an aspect ratio as high as 8 in the throat
